INFOWORLD NEWS QUIZ: THIS WEEK IN TECH  Think you know the news? Then prove it. 
First question: What does Yahoo think it's worth? Read on: 
http://www.infoworld.com/tools/quiz/news/2008/02-15/news-quiz-1.php?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-15
 

GEEK WEEK IN REVIEW  Cringely dreams of locking Steve Ballmer and Rupert Murdoch 
in a room to see who comes out alive, while sending SCO CEO Darl McBride spinning 
around a NASCAR track. Read on: 
http://weblog.infoworld.com/robertxcringely/archives/2008/02/yahoo_murdoch_m.html?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-15
 

HP SETTLES PRETEXTING CASES  The company that was busted for spying on reporters 
has paid The New York Times and BusinessWeek to put the matter to rest. Read on: 
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/15/HP-settles-pretexting-cases_1.html?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-15
 

IS YOUR SITE FIPS COMPLIANT?  It had better be, if you intend to work with 
government clients and servers. Read on: 
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/15/07OP-secadvise-fip-compliant_1.html?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-15
 

HOW SOA AND WEB 2.0 ARE MARRIED  The two are inextricably linked such that the 
Web could become the mother of all SOAs, and very quickly at that. Read on: 
http://weblog.infoworld.com/realworldsoa/archives/2008/02/how_soa_and_the.html?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-15
 

MICROSOFT SHAKEUP PREPARES FOR YAHOO DEAL  A number of high-level executives are 
taking on new responsibilities in running Microsoft online services. Read on: 
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/14/Microsoft-executive-shakeup-prepares-for-Yahoo-acquisition_1.html?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-15
 

CRITICAL LINUX BUGS DISCOVERED Three bugs in the Linux kernel could be exploited 
in many ways, though researchers disagree on how dangerous they are. Read on: 
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/14/Critical-Linux-kernel-bugs-discovered_1.html?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-15
 

A NEW FOCUS ON STORAGE ADVICE What once was Storage Insider takes on the more 
apropos Storage Adviser moniker. Read on: 
http://weblog.infoworld.com/storageadviser/archives/2008/02/gearing_up_for.html?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-15
